projects.title: FPGA-Based Cryptographic System
projects.purpose: High-performance AES encryption module implemented in Verilog for FPGA
projects.overview: Designed and verified a pipelined AES-256 encryption core achieving 128 Gbps throughput while optimizing for area. Implemented complete testbench and formal verification.
projects.problem: Need for high-performance, low-area cryptographic hardware for secure data processing in embedded systems.
projects.constraints: Target: <2000 LUTs on Xilinx 7-series FPGA, 100 MHz clock, 128-bit data path
projects.architecture: 5-stage pipeline with parallel S-box implementation and optimized key scheduling
projects.responsibilities: Full RTL design, testbench development, timing closure, and verification methodology
projects.implementation: Pipelined architecture with registered stages for throughput optimization
projects.verification: Comprehensive testbench with known vectors, formal property verification using SymbiYosys
projects.results: Achieved 128 Gbps, occupied 1847 LUTs, met timing at 100 MHz
projects.challenges: Balancing throughput with area constraints required iterative optimization
projects.lessonsLearned: Pipeline depth significantly impacts both throughput and area; timing closure requires early planning
